description: Calculated clearance (Cockcroft-Gault / CKD-EPI) and renal dosage threshold invariants

rules.message: Metformin contraindicated in severe renal impairment (eGFR/CrCl < 30 mL/min/1.73m2): Substantial risk of fatal Metformin-Associated Lactic Acidosis (MALA) due to diminished renal drug clearance.

provenance.source: FDA Drug Safety Communication & ADA Standards of Care
citations: FDA Drug Safety Communication: FDA revises warnings regarding use of the diabetes medicine metformin in certain patients with reduced kidney function (April 2016).
American Diabetes Association. 11. Chronic Kidney Disease and Risk Management: Standards of Care in Diabetes—2024. Diabetes Care 2024;47(Suppl. 1):S219-S230.

rules.message: Aldosterone antagonists contraindicated in advanced renal failure (eGFR/CrCl < 30 mL/min): Severe risk of life-threatening hyperkalemia and cardiac arrest.

provenance.source: KDIGO Clinical Practice Guideline for Diabetes Management in CKD
citations: Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) Diabetes Work Group. KDIGO 2023 Clinical Practice Guideline for the Management of Diabetes in CKD. Kidney Int. 2023.

rules.message: Systemic NSAIDs contraindicated in severe renal impairment (eGFR/CrCl < 30 mL/min): Prostaglandin inhibition triggers acute renal vasoconstriction, precipitating acute kidney injury (AKI).

provenance.source: KDIGO Clinical Practice Guideline for Acute Kidney Injury
citations: KDIGO Clinical Practice Guideline for Acute Kidney Injury. Kidney Int Suppl. 2012;2(1):1-138.

rules.message: DOAC clearance compromise in severe renal insufficiency (CrCl < 25 mL/min): Increased systemic drug exposure markedly elevates major haemorrhage risk. Dose adjustment or unfractionated heparin transition required.

provenance.source: CHEST Guideline and Expert Panel Report on Antithrombotic Therapy
citations: Stevens SM, et al. Antithrombotic Therapy for VTE Disease: Second Update of the CHEST Guideline. CHEST. 2021;160(6):e545-e608.
